title: Okugezesebwa kw’Olwazi Olutaliimu
intro: Ekitundu, eky’obukugu era ekyenyumirizaamu, kyayoola omusika gwabwe mu nsozi zennyini. Naye akabonero akategeerekeka bwe kaasindikibwa gye bali, okugezesebwa okw’okukkiriza n’okuziyiza, amalala gaabwe gaabatwala mu kkubo eritaliiko kudda. Osobola okuzuula ekibinja kino n’ebiva mu kujeemera kwabwe?
clues: Twali bakama b’amayinja, nga tuyoola amayumba ag’ekitalo butereevu mu nsozi.
Omubaka okuva mu bantu baffe bennyini yajja gye tuli, ng’atuyita okusinza Katonda Omu ow’amazima.
Twasaba akabonero okukakasa ebigambo bye, era ekitonde eky’enjawulo ne kireetebwa ng’ekigezo gye tuli.
Twaweebwa ekiragiro eky’enjawulo: okugabana ensibuko y’amazzi gaffe n’ekitonde kino, nga tukireka okunywa ku lunaku lwakyo olwalagirwa.
Mu kwegulumiza kwaffe, abatonotono mu ffe twakola olukwe era ne tujeemera okulabula, nga tukuba ekitonde ekyali kigendereddwa okuba akabonero kaffe.
Twaweebwa ng’ebula ennaku ssatu okuzikirizibwa kwaffe, era oluvannyuma okubwatuka okw’amaanyi ne kutukwata mu maka gaffe, ne tuleka nga tetulina bulamu era nga tufuuse.

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
